caseName: Safeway Stores, Inc. v. Oklahoma Retail Grocers Ass'n
caseNameFull: Safeway Stores, Inc. v. Oklahoma Retail Grocers Association, Inc.

opinions.text:
Appeal from the Supreme Court of Oklahoma.’ The motion of the National Association of Tobacco Distributors, Inc., for leave to file brief, as amicus curiae-, is granted.

Mr. Justice Clark took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
